title: Inbox review: FID-006 · The public HDL reference lists the three accepted builtin forms and who accepts each
body:
## Goal
The inbox panel decides FID-006 in `docs/harness/fidelity-inbox.md`: approved, declined or deferred, by the method in `docs/harness/inbox-panel-brief.md`. Nothing waits for the owner, who may override the status at any time.

## Acceptance criteria
- One panel verdict comment on this issue, headed `## Inbox panel: APPROVED | DECLINED | DEFERRED`: one line per reviewer's position, the reason, the findings it accepted, and `Verified on:`.
- The status is set with `node scripts/inbox.mjs set FID-006 <status>`: `filed (#n)` once approved and filed, otherwise the reason and this issue.

## Verification command
`node scripts/inbox.mjs status FID-006 --not proposed`

## Scope
In: the review, the verdict and the status line. Out: building what the entry proposes, which an approval files as its own issue.

## Files likely touched
`docs/harness/fidelity-inbox.md`

## Risk
`risk:0`: one status line in an inbox.

## Blocked by
—
